title: Maintain and verify third-party components
summary: Dependencies and build artifacts need ownership, version visibility, timely updates, and integrity checks because vulnerable or abandoned components create inherited risk.
review_checks: Identify lockfiles, vendored code, unpinned actions, and unsupported components.
Check that an update and vulnerability-response process exists.
safe_tests: Generate an inventory from local manifests without uploading private source.
Confirm CI can detect a deliberately outdated test dependency.
remediation: Use lockfiles, integrity verification, and an SBOM.
Assign owners and routinely update or remove unsupported components.
